mapper.select: SELECT authority_id AS authorityId, authority_code AS authorityCode, authority_nm AS authorityNm, authority_dc AS authorityDc, authority_level AS authorityLevel, tenant_scoped AS tenantScoped, use_at AS useAt, created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_authority ORDER BY authority_level, authority_code

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_authority WHERE 1=1
AND use_at = #{useAt}
AND authority_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND authority_nm ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND authority_dc ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_authority ( authority_code, authority_nm, authority_dc, authority_level, tenant_scoped, use_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{authorityCode}, #{authorityNm}, #{authorityDc}, #{authorityLevel}, #{tenantScoped}, #{useAt}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_authority SET authority_nm = #{authorityNm}, authority_dc = #{authorityDc}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE authority_id = #{authorityId}
UPDATE tb_authority SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE authority_id = #{authorityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role_menu_permission ( authority_id, menu_id, permission_id, use_at, crt_dt, crt_id, upd_dt, upd_id ) VALUES ( (SELECT authority_id FROM tb_authority WHERE authority_code = #{authorityCode}), (SELECT menu_id FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_code = #{menuCode}), (SELECT permission_id FROM tb_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}), #{useAt}, now(), #{frstRegisterId}, now(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, m.menu_dc AS menuDc, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_ordr AS menuOrdr, m.menu_url AS menuUrl, m.icon_nm AS iconNm, m.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(p.permission_level) = 'write' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, 1 AS accessible FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.menu_id = rmp.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id INNER JOIN tb_authority a ON rmp.authority_id = a.authority_id WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' AND rmp.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND a.authority_code = #{value} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_nm, m.menu_dc, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_ordr, m.menu_url, m.icon_nm, m.use_at ORDER BY m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_ordr, m.menu_id
